item.title: Monaghan man 'proud' of Irish language in county
item.description: A Carrickmacross man is running a Pop up Gaeltacht in the town as part of Seachtaine na Gaeilge. Shane Crosby is a Gaeilgóir (gayle-gore), who is raising his children through Irish, along with his English wife. As a teacher in Gaelscoil Éois in Clones, Shane uses the language in his everyday life, before and after work. item.title: Cavan County Council recognised at national LAMA awards
item.description: Cavan County Council won a national award over the weekend at the 2026 LAMA All Ireland Community & Council Awards. The local authority picked up the award for 'Best Corporate Social Responsibility Project' for the Storm Éowyn Community Response Hubs. The award is recognition of the fantastic collaborative effort and Meitheal spirit displayed by communities, business and the public sector in a time of crisis. item.description: Cavan and Monaghan meet in the Ulster championship on April 19th. However, both may have already been relegated by the time the Ulster championship comes around. item.title: IFA Protest at Bord Bia ends
item.description: The IFA has stood down its protest at Bord Bia headquarters. There will be a governance review into the matters raised by the IFA in recent weeks. Bord Bia chair Larry Murrin will remain as chair of Bord Bia while the review takes place. Advertisement Mr Murrin will not chair the meetings during the review period. The protest that was being held in Ballsbridge has now been suspended.
